advisories.claim: The NO_ROUTE detail says 'the N system(s) on it cut the route', but N is len(profile.avoid_systems), the whole avoid list, not the systems on this route. Reword or count only the systems on the route.

The HIGHSEC-only guard from the old code is gone. ROUTE_BLOCKED_SECURITY is now reported for any security_profile (balanced, safer) when the shortest profile connects. Confirm that is intended; the brief does not say.

This file is outside the brief's file list. The diff only reflows the import block and adds '# noqa: E402' to each import line, with no reason beside the suppressions (CLAUDE.md requires one). The file is marked gui, and the lead's run reports '7 deselected', so these edits may never have run.

The 'shortest' assertion that follows does prove it.
